title: E2E Networks: 76.6% Margin, 32.5% Profit. Why the Gap?

beats.say: Does this company make seventy seven rupees on every hundred? Or thirty two and a half? E two E Networks rents out chips for A I, called G P Us. In its unaudited July to September results, of every hundred rupees billed, almost seventy seven were left after running costs. Profit after tax was thirty two and a half. Where did the other forty four go?
beats.cap: Does this company make ₹77 on every ₹100? Or ₹32.50? E2E Networks rents out chips for AI, called GPUs. In its unaudited July to September 2026 results, of every ₹100 billed, almost ₹77 (₹76.60) was left after running costs. Profit after tax was ₹32.50. Where did the other ₹44 go (our arithmetic)?
